description: nhflow_2d_beach_suspended_mpi2 with the semi-implicit momentum (A 510 12) and k-epsilon (A 560 1, wall functions A 519 1), 1200 steps. The semi-implicit momentum leaves columns without water (dry, or flagged wet with a depth of zero): the wall value of epsilon had dist = 0 there (inf, 0/0), bicgstab returned the old k and epsilon of the whole domain from step 874 on. Now the columns not deeper than the film A 544 are dry for k and epsilon as for the suspended load (nhflow_scalar_wet.h) and the wall law skips dist = 0.
